thread:
tara: proposing to unpin runtime 2.7.0 -> 2.8.0 during 23:00-23:45 UTC to enable the new scheduler. Need QA smoke and a short release note. Objections?
ben: what's the rollback plan if we see regressions?
tara: deploybot will reapply pin to 2.7.0 if error_rate > 2% sustained for 5m or p99 increases > 500ms. Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with manual hold before final ramp.
deploybot: ACK. Will execute canary and post stage metrics.
owen: QA requests a 20m preflight smoke at 22:30-22:50 UTC. We can run the long-seq and kernel-selector checks then.
tara: scheduled. Gate: qa/smoke==pass required. I'll draft a one-line note for the changelog.
qa-bot: smoke scheduled at 22:30. Will post PASS/FAIL.
qa-bot: smoke PASS at 22:51 UTC. Gate cleared.
deploybot: Canary started 23:05 UTC -> 10%. Initial metrics look good. Advancing to 50% at 23:10.
ben: noticing p99 uptick ~420ms in ap-southeast after 50% bump. Not a huge failure but worth watching.
tara: hold at 50% and observe for 10m.
ben: spike persisted and correlated with a specific GPU topology group. Recommend rollback.
tara: agree. deploybot, roll back to pinned runtime now.
deploybot: Executing rollback -> applying runtime pin=2.7.0. Command: `deploybot rollback --target runtime=2.7.0 --reason "p99 spike ap-southeast"`.
deploybot: Rollback complete at 23:18 UTC. Runtime pinned back to 2.7.0. Notifying oncall and filing an incident ticket.
owen: opened issue #912 capturing scheduler mis-selection on that topology and attached traces.
tara: thanks. We'll postpone the unpin to next available window, add the topology check to preflight, and update the release note: "unpin attempt aborted, rollback performed; topology check added." Closing this thread and moving follow-ups to #release-notes and issue #912.
